Your privacy

This website stores information on your device. Some of it is needed for the pages to work. The rest runs only if you agree. You choose what to allow, and you can change your mind at any time. Privacy policy

What you allow

Delivers the pages and remembers the choice you make here. No third party is involved and none of it identifies you.

Apollo.io, a service of ZenLeads Inc. in the United States, receives your IP address and the pages you open, and matches the address against its own database of company networks. It tells us which companies read our work, not which people. It sets no cookies, but it stores an identifier in your browser.

Get Started

Baukosten KI

Cost estimates to DIN 276. Fees to HOAI.

A cost figure before the design is settled, with a derivation you can follow. For design offices, architects and engineering practices.

Go to baukosten-ki.de

What the application does

Cost estimate
A total to DIN 276, first level, with a range.
Derivation
Per item the benchmark set, the benchmark per square meter, the regional factor, the index level and the edition of the benchmarks.
Fees
Worked out to HOAI 2021 for the buildings service profile, across all service phases.
Description
You describe the project in your own words. The application reads the building type, the standard and the size out of it.
Output
PDF, Excel and ZIP, with your own office details in the header.
Languages
German and English.

How you get to the figure

  1. Describe the project

    You write what it is about, in your own words. The application reads the input values out of it.

  2. Estimate the cost

    You get a total to DIN 276 with a range, and the derivation per item alongside it.

  3. Work out the fee

    The fee calculation to HOAI builds on that estimate. You export the result as PDF, Excel or ZIP.

Where the application stops

So you know what is not in it before you try it.

DIN 276
Benchmarks at the first level. No breakdown into KG 310, KG 320 and the rest.
HOAI
The buildings service profile under § 34 only. No outdoor facilities, no interiors, no building services.
Regional factors
At state level. Neither district nor municipal level.
Account
One user per account. No team function.
Scope of work
New build above ground. Work on existing stock is not in the benchmarks yet.

Die Zahl, die trägt.

Seven days with everything above. The trial starts when you register, asks for no payment details and ends by itself. It does not roll into a paid contract.
